propositions: Current CLI facade (714 lines) reconstructs command identity through 19 overlapping frozensets, regex-based reference generation, and 54 hand-maintained help resources, causing parser/help drift to pass undetected.
Twenty-one intercept-only commands lack canonical help: `rebar help <command>` reports them unknown while inconsistent handler-owned `--help` may execute work.
Runtime and build-time must derive all command syntax/options from a single side-effect-free stdlib argparse factory to establish one authoritative grammar source.

Generated package-help and overview bytes must be committed and pre-operation authoritative so help/unknown paths complete before operation snapshot, config materialization, mount, or handler resolution.
Semantic capability registry must map capabilities to extras and missing postures (error, unavailable, abstain, fallback) without eager optional imports.
Help/unknown paths must never compose operations, mount, or init; execution must retain central mount, strict init, confirmation, legacy JSON shapes, and established streams/exit codes.
